report.scope: All glyphs unlocked; bounded mathematical-orbit optimization using training targets only.
report.objective: sum(pattern.weight * nearest64bitHammingError); lower bound before actual renderer selection and circle restrictions.
report.normalization: Each case receives equal weight; pixel error is divided by its actual visible sphere-pixel area and frame count.
report.searchLimits: Compare current font and fresh gain-per-slot greedy palette, then at most maxSwaps improving equal-size orbit replacements. This is not a global optimum.
